description: As fold_calibrated_narrow, built on the fast-hydrolysis calibration (calibrate_folds.py --arrhenius --bound k_hyd_ch 0.1 2.88, in ADM1_BENCHMARKS_DIR) and scaling the rates by the same Arrhenius factors. With k_hyd_ch above the dilution rate, a temperature step gives the gas peak that comes back, and f_ch lies mid-range, where the network can still move it with the loading rate.
